description: Compile Shader Park JavaScript sculpture code with shader-park-core and instantiate it as a self-contained TouchDesigner GLSL MAT scene with live controls. Caller source requires TDMCP_RAW_PYTHON=on and TDMCP_BRIDGE_ALLOW_EXEC=1. Use the companion shader-park:tox script when you specifically want the official Shader Park .tox plugin workflow.

code.description: Shader Park sculpture code. Example: `let size = input(); sphere(size);`. The code is compiled with shader-park-core and stored in a Text DAT for editing.

expose_controls.description: Expose Speed / Scale / Opacity / StepSize / CameraZ plus any float Shader Park inputs.

name.description: Name of the created baseCOMP container.

parent_path.description: Parent COMP path for the new sculpture.

speed.description: Animation speed multiplier for the Shader Park `time` uniform.

step_size.description: Initial Shader Park raymarch stepSize uniform value.

uniform_values.description: Initial values for Shader Park `input()` uniforms by name, e.g. `{ "size": 0.55 }`.

name: create_shader_park
title: Create Shader Park sculpture
